an4.55:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Bhaggesu viharati Suṃsumāragire Bhesakalāvane migadāye.
an4.55:1.3: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Nakulapituno gahapatissa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an4.55:1.4: Atha kho Nakulapitā ca gahapati Nakulamātā ca gahapatānī yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Nakulapitā gahapati Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca : 2.
an4.55:2.1: Yato me bhante Nakulamātā gahapatānī daharass' eva daharā ānītā nābhijānāmi Nakulamātaraṃ gahapatāniṃ manasā pi aticaritā, kuto pana kāyena
an4.55:2.2: iccheyyāma mayaṃ bhante diṭṭh' eva dhamme aññamaññaṃ passituṃ abhisamparāyañ ca aññamaññaṃ passitun ti?
an4.55:2.3: Nakulamātā pi kho gahapatānī Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an4.55:2.4: :--Yatvāhaṃ bhante Nakulapituno gahapatissa daharass' eva daharā ānītānābhijānāmi Nakulapitaraṃ gahapatiṃ manasā pi aticaritā, kuto pana kāyena
an4.55:2.5: iccheyyāma mayaṃ bhante diṭṭh' eva dhamme aññamaññaṃ passituṃ abhisamparāyañ ca aññamaññaṃ passitun ti? Ākaṅkheyyuṃ
an4.55:3.1: ce gahapatayo ubho jānipatayo diṭṭh' eva dhamme aññamaññaṃ passituṃ abhisamparāyañ ca aññamaññaṃ passituṃ ubho ca assu samasaddhā samasīlā samacāgā samapaññā te diṭṭh' eva dhamme aññamaññaṃ passanti abhisamparāyañ ca aññamaññaṃ passantīti. 3.
